description: Fine-tuning on real shots (hybrid training, step b) and scoring on the held-out test batch (step c). Decoder prior for MWPM: calibrated_coherence on the device patch with the readout-window extension, Ramsey T2, asymmetric readout and QND flips. Fine-tune on the finetune split of batches 1 and 2, early-stop on their validation split, weights pulled towards the pre-trained ones (l2_to_init). Then the two-layer cascade (Sal, 2026-10-25 ~00:00 UTC): the fine-tuned LSTM decides shots with confidence |2p - 1| >= tau, Relay-BP the rest, correlated MWPM where Relay-BP does not converge; tau tuned on the validation split only.
